styles.title: Electric
styles.body: For those who seek an all-out party. Our electric setup is the classic way to dial an event up to eleven, featuring current chart-toppers, 90s throwbacks, and anthems that get everyone onto the dance floor.

styles.title: Acoustic
styles.body: With our carefully curated repertoire, our acoustic setup ensures that your event encapsulates a relaxed, unplugged atmosphere while remaining professional and friendly throughout.

styles.title: Roaming
styles.body: The ultimate crowd-pleaser, this set up is unforgettable at networking events and drinks receptions. A roaming option allows us to perform right in the middle of the crowd, weaving around tables and guests, creating a genuinely impressive atmosphere and lively experience.

add_ons.title: Afternoon acoustic
add_ons.body:
Ahead of the main event, an acoustic afternoon sets a convivial tone for the day.

Featuring the whole band, this is one of the most popular add-ons, and is ideal for larger drinks receptions, garden parties, and networking occasions.

add_ons.title: Live DJ service
add_ons.body:
You know how the interval between live sets can lull a little in energy? Our Live DJ Service ensures that the spirit of your event stays strong.

This upgrade includes a band member acting as DJ for your pre-agreed Spotify playlist, reading the room and selecting songs that perfectly suit the vibes and thrill your most ardent dance floor enthusiasts.

add_ons.title: Jukebox
add_ons.body:
Calling all music diehards! Choosing the Jukebox lets you tailor your event’s setlist by selecting up to 30 songs from our repertoire.

Plus, we’ll make sure to arrange your choices in a way that works best for your event. There truly is no greater way to indulge your love of music than to take charge of the tunes.

add_ons.title: Ceremony
add_ons.body:
Dreaming of walking down the aisle to your favourite song? Instead of a recorded track, make the occasion as special as it deserves with live music.

We create an ambient backdrop for the important parts of your big day, including: guest arrival, processional, signing of the register, exchanging rings, and the momentous recessional as you head out into the world.

add_ons.title: Speeches
add_ons.body:
You’ve gone to all that trouble to plan your big day; make sure the speeches are just as impactful.

We provide a microphone package to suit your venue setup, plus additional production and extra speakers – all of which is set up and run by our sound engineer so you’ll have professional quality throughout. (However, we cannot take responsibility for the quality of any dad jokes.)

add_ons.title: Award ceremony
add_ons.body:
Don’t let your award winners fade into the background; we’ll accompany each of your awards and prizewinners with intro music or a sting to elevate the event into a true celebration.

We also include 2 wireless mics so that both the compere and winners can share the spotlight.

add_ons.title: Solo
add_ons.body:
Some events simply call for a sublime solo. This atmospheric add-on includes acoustic guitar and vocals from Lee, for up to 1 x 60-minute set.

Perfect for intimate drinks receptions and mingling moments before a main evening event.

add_ons.title: Additional songs
add_ons.body:
You know that one song that would make all the difference to your event? Maybe it’s your first dance or company anthem – we’ll learn it for you.

We learn the first additional song free of charge, and further songs can be built into your quote.

add_ons.title: Additional set
add_ons.body: Can’t get enough of live music? Neither can we! We can play an additional 60-minute set, so why not keep the party going with heaps more music (and dancing)!

add_ons.title: Early arrival/ Late finish
add_ons.body: Hosting a longer event? Or do you need to work with specific event timings? We can work with your plans to arrive early or stay later, to ensure you have the right set up on the day.

add_ons.title: Special requests
add_ons.body: After something else that we’ve not listed? Not a problem. Let us know your ideas and we’ll build you something bespoke.
